source_title: India Uttarakhand Helicopter Crash: Who Were The Six On Board? Pilot, Five Passengers Identified
source_excerpt:
Uttarakhand Helicopter Crash: The six people aboard the helicopter that crashed near Joshimath in Uttarakhand’s Chamoli district on Friday have been identified. The passengers were reportedly from Bengaluru, while the aircraft was being flown by Captain Himanshu. According to the list shared by the Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority (UCADA), the five passengers are:-
- Captain Himanshu – Pilot - Prathapa – Passenger - Arun – Passenger - Shankar Gowda – Passenger - Sudheer K – Passenger - HS Natraja – Passenger
ALSO READ: 'Rumours About Fertiliser, LPG Shortages': PM Modi Accuses Oppn Of Creating Panic Amid Gulf Tensions A separate list circulating in reports gives expanded versions of some names, identifying them as Arun Salunke, H S Nagaraja, Prathapa Bachihally Ningarajan, Sudheer K and Shankargowda VB. According to the Chamoli district administration, all six people on board were men.
The helicopter was operated by Trans Bharat Aviation Pvt. Ltd. and carried the call sign VT-HCX. It was travelling from Badrinath to Sahastradhara in Dehradun when it lost contact near Joshimath.
UCADA said the aircraft took off at approximately 1:14 pm. Its tracking system stopped recording its location while it was flying over the Joshimath valley.
The helicopter was later reported to have crashed near Chaien village, close to Joshimath. Smoke was spotted in the forested area above the JP Dam, prompting authorities to intensify the search. Chamoli District Disaster Management Officer Nandkishore Joshi said a white object was seen burning in the forest area above the JP Dam, raising suspicion that it could be the missing aircraft.
Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami said a joint rescue operation was launched with the district administration, disaster management department and State Disaster Response Force (SDRF).
In a post on X, he said: “We have received the unfortunate news of a helicopter crash near Chaien village, close to Joshimath. A joint rescue operation is being conducted by the district administration, disaster management department, and SDRF. I am continuously monitoring the entire incident. Instructions have been given to immediately airlift the seriously injured to higher centres for better treatment...”
The Joshimath Sub-Divisional Magistrate also confirmed that teams from the Army, SDRF, police and health department were being sent to the site.
There were six people on board: pilot Captain Himanshu and five passengers identified as Prathapa, Arun, Shankar Gowda, Sudheer K, and HS Natraja. The passengers were reportedly from Bengaluru.
The helicopter was operated by Trans Bharat Aviation Pvt. Ltd. It carried the call sign VT-HCX.
The helicopter was traveling from Badrinath to Sahastradhara in Dehradun. It lost contact while flying over the Joshimath valley.

शुक्रवार को उत्तराखंड के चमोली जिले में जोशीमठ के पास एक हेलीकॉप्टर दुर्घटनाग्रस्त हो गया। ट्रांस भारत एविएशन प्राइवेट लिमिटेड द्वारा संचालित यह हेलीकॉप्टर (कॉल साइन VT-HCX) बद्रीनाथ से देहरादून के सहस्त्रधारा जा रहा था, तभी जोशीमठ घाटी के ऊपर इसका संपर्क टूट गया।

## घटना का विवरण
* **उड़ान मार्ग:** बद्रीनाथ से सहस्त्रधारा, देहरादून
* **ऑपरेटर:** ट्रांस भारत एविएशन प्राइवेट लिमिटेड
* **अनुमानित उड़ान समय:** दोपहर 1:14 बजे
* **घटना स्थल:** चिएन गांव के पास, जेपी बांध के ऊपर का जंगल

## सवार व्यक्तियों की पहचान
उत्तराखंड नागरिक उड्डयन विकास प्राधिकरण (UCADA) ने दुर्घटना के समय विमान में सवार छह लोगों की पहचान की है। इनमें पायलट कैप्टन हिमांशु और पांच यात्री—प्रतापा, अरुण, शंकर गौड़ा, सुधीर के. और एचएस नटराज शामिल हैं। मीडिया रिपोर्ट्स के अनुसार, सभी यात्री बेंगलुरु के निवासी बताए जा रहे हैं।

## बचाव अभियान
जेपी बांध के ऊपर जंगल में धुआं देखे जाने के बाद अधिकारियों ने खोज तेज कर दी। उत्तराखंड के मुख्यमंत्री पुष्कर सिंह धामि ने पुष्टि की कि जिला प्रशासन, आपदा प्रबंधन विभाग और राज्य आपदा प्रतिक्रिया बल (SDRF) द्वारा संयुक्त बचाव अभियान चलाया जा रहा है। जोशीमठ के उप-विभागीय मजिस्ट्रेट ने बताया कि सेना, पुलिस और स्वास्थ्य विभाग की टीमों को घटनास्थल पर भेजा गया है ताकि राहत कार्य सुनिश्चित किया जा सके और घायलों को बेहतर उपचार के लिए एयरलिफ्ट किया जा सके।
hi_title: उत्तराखंड के जोशीमठ के पास हेलीकॉप्टर दुर्घटनाग्रस्त, छह लोग थे सवार

en_body:
Authorities have identified the six individuals on board a helicopter that crashed near Chaien village, close to Joshimath in Uttarakhand’s Chamoli district on Friday. The aircraft, operated by Trans Bharat Aviation Pvt. Ltd. (call sign VT-HCX), was en route from Badrinath to Sahastradhara in Dehradun when it lost contact while flying over the Joshimath valley.

## Incident Details
* **Flight Path:** Badrinath to Sahastradhara, Dehradun
* **Operator:** Trans Bharat Aviation Pvt. Ltd.
* **Reported Takeoff:** Approximately 1:14 pm
* **Location of Incident:** Forested area near Chaien village, above JP Dam

## Occupants Identified
The Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority (UCADA) confirmed the occupants included the pilot, Captain Himanshu, and five passengers identified as Prathapa, Arun, Shankar Gowda, Sudheer K, and HS Natraja. Reports indicate the passengers were from Bengaluru.

## Rescue Operations
Following reports of smoke spotted in the forest above JP Dam, Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami confirmed a joint rescue mission involving the district administration, the disaster management department, and the State Disaster Response Force (SDRF). The Joshimath Sub-Divisional Magistrate stated that teams from the Army, police, and health department were deployed to the crash site to assist with emergency operations. Officials are currently working to verify the status of those on board and have initiated procedures for medical evacuation where necessary.
en_title: Helicopter Carrying Six Crashes Near Joshimath in Uttarakhand
